scope: Primary sources used to delimit proved rank-2-through-5 braided and modular classification results. Braided-equivalence counts are not silently promoted to ribbon-equivalence counts.

references.title: On Classification of Modular Tensor Categories

locators.claim: All unitary modular tensor categories of rank at most 4 are classified up to ribbon tensor equivalence.
The unitary rank-at-most-4 fusion families are listed.

references.title: On Classification of Modular Categories by Rank

locators.claim: Every rank-5 modular category is Grothendieck equivalent to SU(2)_4, PSU(2)_9, SU(5)_1, or PSU(3)_4.
This theorem classifies fusion rules, not the number of distinct modular structures on those fusion categories.

references.title: Classification of Rank 5 Premodular Categories

locators.claim: The paper classifies pseudo-unitary rank-5 premodular categories.

references.current_scope_warning: Use together with ref:dong-schopieray-near-integral-2024. The 2024 paper explains that the earlier rank-5 description is complete only at Grothendieck level and misses braided realizations.

locators.claim: The paper completes the classification of premodular fusion categories of rank at most 6 up to braided equivalence.
The tabulation is up to braided equivalence and explicitly does not classify all pivotal or spherical structures.
The tables enumerate low-rank braided classes, including modular rows and spherical-structure multiplicities where stated.
